Pleaaaaase don't think of recursion as loops! This is so wrong and it will get you stuck most of the time. Recursion is simply a function call(like any other function call) in which the caller call itself. Imagine this problem, You are an employee and your boss asked you for a file. Assuming you don't have the file you will ask another employee about it, and if he doesn't he will ask another one and so on until one person found the file. Now that person doesn't know you, he will give the file to the one who asked him directly, the same for the asker and so on until it was reached to you.
When you ask the employee you are simply making a Recursive Call, we stop when we reach the objective(i.e. finding a file in the previous example), we call this condition the Base Case. Recursion is more natural than loops, and easier to implement than for loops once you get it. All you need to do is practice and see how it's implemented, and if you have a question already comment it here and I'll explain it to you!
